Definition: to grow, i.e. (causatively) to enlarge, (figuratively) laud
BiblicalUsage: The word sâgâʼ means to grow, that is (causatively) to enlarge, (figuratively) laud. It stands in Job 12:23, "…increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth…", and in Job 36:24, "Remember that thou magnify his work, which men…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sâgâʼ is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
